paragraphs: Welcome to my portfolio! I'm currently a Data Science student at UIT VNU-HCM with hands-on experience across the full analytical workflow — from EDA and feature engineering to machine learning modeling and business-ready dashboards. Proficient in Python, SQL, and Power BI. Seeking an internship to apply data-driven thinking to real business problems and contribute to a collaborative, impact-focused team.
This portfolio showcases my journey, projects, and skills. Feel free to explore and get in touch if you'd like to collaborate!

items.name: Bank Marketing Campaign Analysis & Customer Segmentation
description: Performed exploratory data analysis on 45K+ banking records following the CRISP-DM methodology
Applied Random Forest feature importance and Mutual Information to identify key predictors of customer conversion
Segmented customers into 4 profiles using K-Means Clustering and validated optimal clusters with the Elbow Method
Built an interactive Power BI dashboard to visualize conversion insights and customer segments for business stakeholders

items.name: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis on Tiki Reviews
description: Built a Vietnamese sentiment analysis dataset by scraping and processing Tiki product reviews
Developed a semi-automatic annotation pipeline using Gemini API with Human-in-the-Loop validation
Implemented NLP preprocessing and machine learning workflows for multi-aspect sentiment classification
Achieved a Macro-F1 score of 53.33% in a low-resource Vietnamese NLP setting
